subject.title: fix(heartbeat): bound HEARTBEAT.md file read size

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally stop applying `HEARTBEAT.md` files over 16 MiB while allowing the heartbeat run and delivery to continue with only a gateway warning?
rationale: This is a sensible safety bound, but it changes previously accepted user input and can make automation instructions disappear after upgrade without failing the run; the permanent threshold and failure experience require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept bounded fail-open behavior
options.body: Keep the 16 MiB cap and warning, accepting that oversized instructions are ignored so a malicious or accidental file cannot drive unbounded memory use.

options.title: Fail the heartbeat visibly
options.body: Reject the run with a surfaced operator error when the file is oversized, trading availability for stronger assurance that instructions never disappear behind a successful status.

options.title: Preserve oversized compatibility
options.body: Retain large-file support or add an explicit limit setting, preserving unusual existing setups at the cost of more configuration or continued resource exposure.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded fail-open behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the 16 MiB cap and warning, accepting that oversized instructions are ignored so a malicious or accidental file cannot drive unbounded memory use.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing signal for the heartbeat runner and its missing-file compatibility behavior.
